objective_unchanged: original cost comparison inside evaluate_plan and _recovery_prefers; H remains the existing constraint, not a new objective
developer_screen_not_a_model_constraint: Comparing adopted makespan with the saved M48 plan is a later review note. It is not passed into the model and it is not a new hard gate.

stages.name: INIT_BASE
stages.trigger: simulate creates Budget(alg.recovery_init_eval_budget) before initial_recovery. Both sealed simulate.py copies are byte-identical and use 100.

stages.name: INIT_RESCUE
stages.amount: the existing rescue_evals argument, which the sealed caller sets to main_limit (1000). Not a second main budget and not a new extend.
stages.trigger: best is None and evals_left()<=0 and rescue_used is false. One extend. S and X use the same rule.
stages.evidence: M48 recovery.py _rescue_check budget.extend(rescue_evals); M48 and 39a85 simulate.py both pass rescue_evals=main_limit. 39a85 recovery.py keeps that same check.

stages.name: INIT_FALLBACK
stages.trigger: not best_s_eligible and tried_entries is non-empty. Rebuild-fallback entries only. Not the main ALNS loop.
stages.evidence: M48 recovery.py and 39a85 recovery.py both budget.extend(24) under that condition.

stages.name: INIT_JOINT
stages.trigger: (joint or land_and_wait or unlaunched) and best is None, then _joint_retarget extends by JOINT_EXTRA_EVALS. On these two cases setup reports joint, unlaunched, and land_and_wait all true, so the trigger can fire only while init still has no feasible plan.
stages.evidence: JOINT_EXTRA_EVALS = 60 in M48 recovery.py and in 39a85 recovery.py.

stages.name: INIT_LAND_EXTRA
stages.trigger: added inside the same _joint_retarget extend only when land_and_wait or unlaunched is true. It is not added on a recovery that already has a feasible init plan.
stages.evidence: LAND_EXTRA_EVALS = 120; extend is JOINT_EXTRA_EVALS + LAND_EXTRA_EVALS when that flag is set.

stages.name: MAIN
stages.trigger: After initial_recovery returns a plan, simulate creates a new Budget(main_limit) and calls optimize. If init returns nothing, main stays 0. This object is not added onto the init budget.
stages.evidence: simulate.py: budget = Budget(main_limit, ...) after the initial_recovery call, commented as the main-loop budget.

not_registered: a new +1000 on top of the inherited rescue
a hard-suffix evaluate outside the episode
a second paid attempt on the same visible state

rng.when: first recovery main search uses replan_index+1 with replan_index starting at 0. Init does not use this RNG.
